theorems.name: Submission.cbrld_cone_cycle_eval_eq_zero_of_const_on_ball
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1)) (x₀ : Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (α : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1)) (φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (n + 1)), 0 < r → X.boundary = 0 → X.support ⊆ ball x₀ r → (∀ x ∈ ball x₀ r, (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (n + 1)) x = α) → X φ = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
